newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow Wednesday, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand rather light.
Sales confirmed on 1,700 slaughter steers and 2,500 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 14,700 head confirmed, including 9,500 head contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1275 lbs including Brahma cross 70.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1150 lbs 70.00; mixed Commercial to Choice 1200-1250 lb heifers and heiferettes 69.00. Confirmed - 4,200 last week - 900 last year - 13,400
Wk to date - 14,700 last week - 45,200 last year - 25,900
